item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia freed American Stephen Hubbard during US envoy Steve Witkoff's talks with President Putin, following a positive meeting between Witkoff and President Zelenskyy. Ukraine conducted its first drone airlift of a wounded soldier from the front line, while Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv, injuring six people, and later bombarded the city after the talks. Russian strikes killed at least nine civilians and injured 57 across Ukraine, and a mass missile and drone attack hit Kyiv. Zelenskyy backed freezing the front line as a first step toward a ceasefire, and Ukrainian forces launched a secret counteroffensive in the heavily fortified Donbas. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

UNICEF reported that 340 children have been killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire, and an Israeli minister called for settling the entire West Bank, with a far-right rival offered a Gaza expulsion portfolio if he quits the election. Reuters noted the detained Americans were later released and AIPAC halted endorsements and direct contributions to candidates. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

In response, US diplomats were ordered to leave Saudi Arabia as the threat from Houthi attacks grew. Egypt’s president said Egypt will defend Saudi territory but will not attack Yemen. Yemen government forces reported killing or wounding 285 Houthis in 835 strikes. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Syria: the situation
item.description:

Syrian security forces carried out operations that dismantled an ISIS mercenary cell and killed a member of the Defence Ministry in Eastern Ghouta, and a civilian was killed during an Israeli operation in Syria. The Syrian People’s Assembly is advancing a broad legislative overhaul covering employment, penal, property and national security law, and a British aid worker’s daughter continues searching for her father’s body after his death in Syria. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:
Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own civil war intensifies and has refused to intervene in the South West State conflict. The UAE carried out its first drone strike in nearly a year, killing four family members including a pregnant teenager in Puntland, and the US and UAE launched airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
